name: Clean Energy Program
description: ADB's umbrella initiative to accelerate low-carbon energy transition across Asia and the Pacific. Focuses on scaling renewable energy capacity, enhancing energy grid efficiency, and phasing out fossil fuels.
target: Deploy 15 GW of new renewable energy capacity by 2030, reducing carbon emissions across partner countries.

name: Climate Change Operational Framework 2030
description: The guiding policy framework directing all ADB projects to align with international climate actions under the Paris Agreement. Facilitates sovereign and private investments in mitigation and adaptation.
target: Provide $100 Billion in cumulative climate finance from ADB's own resources by 2030.

name: Water Financing Program
description: ADB's strategic initiative to address the regional water crisis. Promotes sustainable freshwater management, wastewater treatment, river basin protection, and irrigation efficiency.
target: Provide safe water access and sanitation to 340 million people, and modern irrigation to 10 million hectares of farmland.

name: Sustainable Agriculture and Food Security Program
description: Focuses on climate-resilient farming, food supply chain decarbonization, reduction of methane emissions from rice cultivation, and soil nutrient management.
target: Allocate $14 Billion between 2022-2025 to ease food insecurity and transition regional agriculture to sustainable practices.

name: Sustainable Infrastructure and Urban Development
description: Integrates green building standards, waste-to-energy technologies, public transit modernization, and smart urban systems to build resilient cities in developing member countries.
target: Deliver climate-resilient urban solutions to 50 target cities, reducing local aerosol emissions and heat island effects.

name: Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services Program
description: Invests in nature-based solutions (NbS), coastal mangrove restoration, protection of critical habitats, and combatting illegal wildlife trade to prevent biodiversity loss.
target: Protect and restore 5.5 million hectares of natural terrestrial and marine ecosystems by 2030.
